entities.summary: Giampiero Gloder is an Italian prelate of the Catholic Church who has worked in the diplomatic service of the Holy See in 1993. He was named Apostolic Nuncio to Cuba in October 2019 after serving as president of the Pontifical Ecclesiastical Academy since 2013 and Vice Camerlengo of the Holy Roman Church from 2014 to 2019.
